info.title: StreamAtlas prototype contracts
info.description: Node/SQLite source-of-truth endpoint contract subset. Literal routes and source-reviewed API regex/method predicates have strict inventory gates. Typed request/response and runtime authorization parity remain partial; broad Object schemas are not behavioral acceptance. NOT a production publishing approval.

put.description: The private single-writer SQLite upload spool is synced before progress is committed. A crash may leave extra spool bytes; only byte-identical replay can repair them. This does not provide distributed locking or S3 multipart resumability.
